infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GPS Manhunt requires your location to position you on the game field and calculate directions during an active match.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GPS Manhunt requires background location while a match is actively running to allow you to play with your device in your pocket.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow GPS Manhunt to track your position while a chase match is active.
